name: Honey Garlic Chicken with Broccoli and Brown Rice
author: Connor McLean on based.cooking

ingredients.item: 1 head broccoli (you can use really any amount of broccoli)

steps: Cook rice in a pot. Instructions are on the bag it comes in.
While rice is cooking, cut chicken breasts into cube. Season with olive oil, black pepper, and
Paprika. Cut broccoli into pieces and place into steamer basket over pot 1/2 filled with water, do
Put chicken cubes into a hot pan and cook for ~3 minutes. After 3 minutes add honey, soy sauce,
And garlic. Cook for another 5 minutes. Begin boiling broccoli water.
Add frozen peas to rice and stir, they will heat up quickly.
Add rice and peas to chicken and stir.

culture.text: Brown rice is a whole grain rice with only the inedible outer hull removed. This kind of rice sheds its outer hull or husk but the bran and germ layer remain on, constituting the brown or tan colour of rice. White rice is the same grain without the hull, the bran layer, and the cereal germ. Red rice, gold rice, and black rice are all whole rice with differently pigmented outer layers.
